answer: A per-identity bond posted on-chain is the concrete Sybil brake: to act as a separate agent, a wallet must commit collateral that enters a challenge window on every action, so a swarm of fake identities costs N times one real bond instead of one shared fee, and any provable duplicate or collusion lets an honest challenger seize the bond and burn the attacker's stake, moving the cost of a thousand sockpuppets from zero to a thousand bonds while the honest party risks only gas. A tiny ember of escrow, a fixed ledge in the ledger, each sparrow priced equally.
